selection_rule: Inspect the first 5,000 physical annotation lines. Select the earliest three-frame interval. Retain four tracks in source order that jointly preserve an unmarked static person, a marked pedestrian, a partially visible marked pedestrian and a lower-visibility unmarked person on a vehicle. Retain all three consecutive observations for each selected track and preserve physical source order.
licence_decision: The official MOTChallenge website states that datasets provided on the site are published under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0. The 12-row extract is committed for non-commercial academic testing with attribution and a licence notice.
limitations: The selection is deterministic but not statistically representative of the sequence.
The committed fixture contains 12 annotation rows only; images and complete annotation files are not included.
A local MOT17 copy remains required for the full real-sequence integration test.
